name: useVisionAI
summary: Nine on-device vision capabilities, plus cloud scene understanding.
plain: Everything image-related in one hook. Locally it can read text, scan barcodes, find faces and poses, label objects and cut out the subject. For open-ended questions about a picture it can also send the image to Gemini.
description: The on-device half wraps the ML Kit vision models through pixel-nano and runs without a network: barcode scanning, text recognition v2, face detection with landmarks and head angles, 468-point face mesh, image labelling, object detection with tracking, 33-point pose detection, selfie and subject segmentation, and digital ink recognition. The cloud half sends a captured or picked image to Gemini and asks for a description plus structured labels. Each on-device call reports its own latency.

returns.name: selectedImageUri
returns.desc: Image currently loaded, from the camera or the picker.

returns.name: analysis
returns.desc: Cloud description and labels with latency.

returns.name: isOnDeviceProcessing
returns.desc: True during any local vision call.

returns.name: ocrResult
returns.desc: Recognised text with per-block bounding boxes.

returns.name: barcodeResult
returns.desc: Decoded barcodes with format and position.

returns.name: facesResult
returns.desc: Faces with head angles, smile and eye-open probabilities.

returns.name: objectsResult
returns.desc: Detected objects with tracking ids across frames.

returns.name: model
returns.desc: Cloud model used for scene analysis.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

actions.name: captureAndAnalyze(useCamera?)
actions.desc: Takes or picks a photo and sends it to Gemini for a description and labels.

inputs.name: useCamera
inputs.desc: True opens the camera and asks for permission, false opens the library. Defaults to true.

actions.output: Resolves with { description, labels, latencyMs, timestamp }, or null when the user cancelled, no API key is configured, or the call failed.

actions.name: pickImage(useCamera?)
actions.type: (useCamera?: boolean) => Promise<{ uri: string; base64?: string } | null>
actions.desc: Opens the camera or the library and loads an image without analysing it.

inputs.name: useCamera
inputs.desc: True for the camera, false for the library. Defaults to true.

actions.output: Resolves with the file URI and base64 copy, also stored in selectedImageUri and selectedImageBase64. Null when cancelled or permission was refused.

actions.name: recognizeText(image)
actions.desc: Reads text from an image, on the device.

inputs.name: imageInput
inputs.desc: A file URI or a base64 image.

actions.output: Resolves with { text, blocks, latencyMs, source }; blocks keep the line and bounding-box structure. Null on failure.

actions.name: scanBarcodes(image)
actions.desc: Finds and decodes 1D and 2D codes, including QR.

inputs.name: imageInput
inputs.desc: A file URI or a base64 image.

actions.output: Resolves with { barcodes, latencyMs, source }; each barcode carries rawValue, displayValue, format, valueType and a bounding box. Null on failure.

actions.name: detectFaces(image)

inputs.name: imageInput
inputs.desc: A file URI or a base64 image.

actions.output: Resolves with { faces, latencyMs, source }; each face carries a tracking id, head Euler angles, a bounding box, and smile and eye-open probabilities that are null when classification is off. Null on failure.

actions.name: detectObjects(image)
actions.desc: Detects and tracks objects with labels.

inputs.name: imageInput
inputs.desc: A file URI or a base64 image.

actions.output: Resolves with { objects, latencyMs, source }; each object carries a tracking id, a bounding box and labels with confidences. Null on failure.

actions.name: detectPose(image)

inputs.name: imageInput
inputs.desc: A file URI or a base64 image.

actions.output: Resolves with { landmarks, latencyMs, source } — 33 landmarks, each with a type, x, y and an in-frame likelihood. Null on failure.

actions.name: segmentSubject(image)
actions.desc: Separates the main subject from the background.

inputs.name: imageInput
inputs.desc: A file URI or a base64 image.

actions.output: Resolves with { subjectsCount, foregroundConfidence, latencyMs, source }. Null on failure.

agentNote: Prefer the on-device calls: they are faster, work offline and never send the image anywhere. Only use captureAndAnalyze when the question is genuinely open-ended.
